scenes.narration: The machine says she's lying. She says... it's the machine. And you've got four minutes... until nine fourteen.
scenes.visual: lobby, clock 9:10, you and the stranger through the glass

scenes.narration: You open the door. Biscuit gets there first. Tail going crazy. Dogs know.
scenes.visual: door opens, Biscuit jumps at her, wagging

scenes.narration: Her name is Mara. She used to fix the city's power grid. And she talks fast... like someone who's been alone too long.
Every night at nine fourteen, the lights come on. Anyone who walks toward them... doesn't come back. That's how she lost her brother.
scenes.visual: flashback: a figure walks toward a lit window and fades

scenes.narration: The lights aren't looking for survivors... they're collecting them.
scenes.visual: city map: dots blinking out one by one

scenes.narration: There's one way to stop it. The substation. Six blocks away. Pull the main breaker... and the city goes dark. Forever.

scenes.visual: the three of you sprint into the dark street

scenes.narration: Nine twelve. Nine thirteen. Behind you, the streetlights start waking up... one by one... following you.
scenes.visual: streetlights switching on behind you as you run

scenes.narration: The breaker is huge. Rusted. It won't move.
scenes.visual: giant rusted breaker lever, you and Mara pulling

scenes.narration: Every light in the city turns toward you... and you pull. With everything you've got.
scenes.visual: blinding light flood, the lever slams down

scenes.narration: Darkness. Real darkness. For the first time in two hundred and twelve nights... it's quiet.
And then you look up. Stars. Thousands of them. You'd forgotten they were there.
For two hundred and twelve nights, you were alone. Tonight... the city is dark. But you're not.
scenes.visual: rooftop under the stars: you, Mara and Biscuit

scenes.narration: Would you have pulled the lever? Tell me in the comments... and follow. Tomorrow... a new story begins.
scenes.visual: end card: THE END, new story tomorrow
